eventDefinitions.definition: Native ProcessInfo.systemUptime immediately before runtime.openGame/openGameRoom or resumeGame, not model/tool request arrival. Public native logger elapsed is measured within that same uptime clock.
Real visible home/detail/mode link activation, with20ms test polling for M3. Document path/timeOrigin observations describe the actual SPA/full-document journey.

Per-document performance entries and renderer snapshots. Main-document completed-request coverage only; no complete worker/pending/all-network wall-time claimed. Do not sum parallel resource durations or subtract3000ms from total to invent resource wait.
Validated genuine ready from initialized gameplay with a render opportunity. Star countdown completion plus playing and renderer ready; accepted inputs are an additional behavioral check.

Play connected state plus actual room snapshot and resolved player/spectator role before room-ready publication. Monotonic root observer before actual UI submit to first read that contains the required authority facts. UI IPC, polling, keyboard routing and operator gaps may be included; never subtract it from Native/Web/server clock.

baselineRows.network: Task-owned loopbackHTTP127.0.0.1:18146 serving frozen production public bytes; fixture identity/catalog preloaded, UIKit animations disabled. Not public network or physical-device performance.

conditions.cold: Fresh WKWebView; only this fixture profile's HTTP memory/disk caches cleared before the tap; WebKit process and OS caches are not reset
conditions.prepared: End the preceding session, clear the same profile's HTTP caches, prepare and verify its current manifest, then open fresh WebViews without clearing the prepared cache
conditions.navigation: Poll public visible links every 20 ms and click as soon as their DOM conditions pass; real SPA or full-document navigation is accepted. This is not an average human think-time model.

baselineRows.firstOpenMeaning: Controlled fresh-WebView/cache condition per sample, not first-ever install or OS/WebKit-process cold start.
baselineRows.coverageLimit: These two representative scenes provide controlled cold/prepared comparisons. They are not Flight creation/join or Star tutorial N10.

baselineRows.cacheCondition: No cache clearing; same retained original document, WebView, named store and launch. This is in-process retention, not a cache-hit claim.
baselineRows.retainedDefinition: Actual minimize toolbar action and completed dismissal; same live WebView, named profile and launch ID, plus strict JavaScript identity with the retained original document and documentElement objects and random in-memory marker. No cache clearing, manufactured lifecycle event or new ready callback.
baselineRows.clock: Native uptime starts immediately before public runtime.resumeGame. The first endpoint is a native visible presentation plus two real Web requestAnimationFrames and current operable DOM state. The second endpoint additionally confirms an actual test input changed game state.
baselineRows.observationOverhead: The native presentation/DOM observers poll at 50 ms, async JavaScript completion at 20 ms; UIKit animations are disabled by the existing isolated fixture. Endpoints are observed upper bounds, not touch-hardware latency.
baselineRows.inputScope: DOM click accepts a Gomoku local move; actual page keyboard handlers accept Space fire in PaperStar local. These are synthetic test inputs through real game handlers, not physical-touch or VoiceOver claims.
baselineRows.scope: Same local candidate and isolated fixture only; retained same-process session, not OS suspension, process eviction, app restart or online room recovery.
notClaimed: Gomoku computer-mode retention measured by this local-mode fixture
